title: Record owner manual cash notes with stable receipt results
requirements: Add only a transactional OwnerCommandService.record_cash_note owner command for the documented semantic payload: expected_version, kind RECEIPT|REFUND_NOTE, positive integer amount_minor, UTC occurred_at and non-empty note. It records a manual fact only; it does not send money, infer payment, calculate a refund, alter agreed terms, or change inquiry/visit workflow status.

Lock business_write_guard then the inquiry and its current participation/visit. The inquiry expected_version is always required. If an active participation exists, require expected_visit_versions to contain exactly that visit id and its current positive version; without active participation, omit expected_visit_versions or supply an empty mapping. Stale/missing versions reject before mutation. The command remains permitted for every persisted inquiry status, including COMPLETED and CANCELLED.

On first acceptance insert exactly one immutable cash_notes record in RUB using the trusted owner_id and server recorded_at, increment inquiry version and the current visit version when present, create one OWNER change_event and receipt links for the inquiry and current visit. Store and return a complete stable result {command_id,inquiry,changed_visits}; snapshot it in operation_receipts.result_json and replay it without rereading later cash facts. Use the canonical path /api/v1/admin/inquiries/{id}/cash-notes.

Preserve existing receipt semantics: owner scope, HMAC digests, identical replay without duplicate note/event/version changes, changed payload IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH, tombstoned or malformed result RESULT_EXPIRED, and rejected requests do not consume the key. Map safe domain failures as typed OwnerCommandError only; no diagnostics or new persistence schema.

Add isolated disposable PostgreSQL tests for RECEIPT and REFUND_NOTE, every inquiry state, positive/RUB/UTC/body validation, active and unplanned version behaviour, atomic version conflicts, stable receipt replay after later cash facts, expired/mismatch, one note/audit/receipt links, and no payment or status prerequisite. Never read local .env or a configured database.
Do not add HTTP routes, corrections, payments integration, checkout, webhooks, invoices, notifications, production composition, migrations, frontend assets, bot adapters, secrets or external calls.
acceptance: The owner command can record a factual receipt or refund note without blocking confirmation or completion and returns a stable full CRM card result.
Version, receipt and audit rules prevent partial cash mutations or duplicate recorded facts.
Focused isolated PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted manual financial-fact command over the existing append-only cash schema; it creates no payment execution, status transition or public surface.
